title: Spindle Drive Thermal Overcurrent
description: Drive reports thermal overcurrent condition. Motor current P002 sustained at {val}% for >60 s. Drive will shut down in {val2} s if condition persists.
probable_cause: Excessive cutting load, incorrect feed/speed parameters, or degraded drive cooling.
remedy: Allow drive to cool (20 min minimum). Clean drive filters. If recurring, upgrade drive to next current rating.
required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.
escalation_path: If SPN-MJ-005 is not addressed (stop current operation. machine must be inspected before resuming production.), the fault will escalate in this order: SPN-CR-002, then THM-MD-001, then SPN-MJ-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
